name: YMCA Camp Pawtucket
description_short: YMCA traditional day camp at the Pawtucket Family YMCA in downtown Pawtucket, grouped by age from Pathfinders (5-6) to Leaders in Training (15-16). Days mix indoor and outdoor activities such as swimming, creative arts, group games and nature exploration, with daily lunch and weekly field trips to Camp Westwood. Specialty weeks include Sports Medley, Art Explosion and the Voyagers travel camp.
activities: weekly field trips to Camp Westwood
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is listed among daily activities; the camp is based at the Pawtucket Family YMCA. Pool details and swim testing are not described.
